Claws Of Wood.Name: Claws Of Wood
Claws Of Wood.Description: Deal 9% more damage to targets with 'Injured'

Trunk Body.Name: Trunk Body
Trunk Body.Description: The first unit in the order of the player's team takes 40% less damage from attacks that are not Fire element attacks and take 30% more damage from Fire element attacks

Breifcase Full Of Bullets.Name: Breifcase Full Of Bullets
Breifcase Full Of Bullets.Description: All unit's with Bullet statuses gain the status 'Reload Case' (0, 1) at encounter start. When going under half of their starting Bullet potency, lose one count of 'Reload Case' to go back to their starting max Bullet potency. Deal 65% more damage when spending Bullet status potency

Elemental Cloak.Name: Elemental Cloak
Elemental Cloak.Description: Grants resistance to one element of choice.

The Cape of the Flame Conqueror.Name: The Cape of the Flame Conqueror
The Cape of the Flame Conqueror.Description: All enemy units gain 'Burn' (3, 3) every turn start
